verdict.rationale: Netlify's docs mention prompting AI agents to fix/update/ship code directly from the dashboard and connecting AI assistants to the account, which supports delegating tasks to a built-in assistant. However, this is thinly documented with no detail on capabilities, limitations, or independent/hands-on corroboration of the feature working as described. missing for 10: detailed documentation of assistant capabilities/scope, hands-on or community validation, clarity on what tasks can be delegated.
